name: Corroded Shrapnel
summary: In Stonetalon, jagged fragments remain buried in the forest’s corrupted treants. The Venture Company’s munitions left them there as the goblins fled.

sections.title: Remnants of Industrial Ruin
sections.body: The Venture Company’s goblins fled Stonetalon’s groves under cover of reckless munitions. Their blasts drove shrapnel into the treants defending the valley, where it lodged deep in bark and core. The ancient guardians slowly succumbed to corruption. Their wood darkened, and they turned their fury on anyone entering the vale. Kaela Shadowspear seeks the rusted fragments for Gaxim Rustfizzle, a gnome who wants to study how the weapons brought on the treants’ corruption.

faq.q: Where does this shrapnel come from?
faq.answer: The shrapnel comes from corrupted treants in the Stonetalon Mountains, including Charred Ancients, Blackened Ancients, and Vengeful Ancients.

faq.q: Why is the shrapnel embedded in the treants?
aliases: how did shrapnel get in treants
why are treants full of metal
faq.answer: The Venture Company’s explosive munitions struck the treants as the forest guardians drove goblin loggers from the vale. Shards lodged in their bark during the battle and remained there.

faq.q: Is the shrapnel responsible for corrupting the forest ancients?
faq.answer: Kaela Shadowspear says Gaxim, a gnome, believes the treants’ corruption is tied to the foul chemical or metallic makeup of the goblins’ weapons as they retreated.

faq.q: Who wants to inspect the shrapnel?
faq.answer: Kaela Shadowspear, a night elf, wants a sample for Gaxim, a gnome inventor. He plans to study its properties and learn what afflicts the treants.

angles.text: As a druid, you see the cost of unchecked exploitation in Kalimdor’s ancients, warped by goblin munitions and festering metal shards.
As a gnome, you can see Gaxim’s study of tainted shrapnel as a practical, scientific way to investigate an ecological mystery the woodland sentinels cannot explain.
